arabicExcerpts.text: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينٖ

mainSubject.label: Oaths by retreating stars that run their courses and disappear, by the closing night and the breathing dawn, establishing the Quran as a word conveyed by a noble messenger possessed of power and secure in position with the Owner of the Throne, obeyed in the heavens and trustworthy; the Prophet affirmed not mad, having seen Gabriel on the clear horizon and not withholding knowledge of the unseen; the Quran declared not the word of an expelled devil
